recommendations.title: Split long JavaScript tasks to minimize Total Blocking Time
recommendations.description: Long tasks (>50ms) occupy the main browser thread, delaying input processing and degrading user responsiveness.

finding.description: Total Blocking Time of 510ms exceeds the 200ms recommended threshold across 1 long task(s) (longest: 66ms) | Script: unknown

recommendations.potentialImpact: Relieves main-thread CPU congestion and eliminates input latency during page load.
recommendations.suggestedFix: Break up long tasks (>50ms) using scheduler.yield() or requestIdleCallback(), defer non-critical JavaScript execution, and offload CPU-intensive work to Web Workers.
recommendations.issue: Split long JavaScript tasks to minimize Total Blocking Time
recommendations.whyItMatters: Relieves main-thread CPU congestion and eliminates input latency during page load.
recommendations.actualValue: Total Blocking Time: 510ms (1 long tasks, max: 66ms)
recommendations.reason: Long JavaScript tasks block the browser main thread from responding to user interactions.
recommendations.suggestedFixSummary: Break up long tasks (>50ms) using scheduler.yield() or requestIdleCallback(), defer non-critical JavaScript execution, and offload CPU-intensive work to Web Workers.

recommendations.title: Provide a meta description for search engine result snippets
recommendations.description: The meta description summarizes page content in search engine result pages, improving user click-through rates.

finding.description: No <meta name="description"> tag was found in document <head>

recommendations.evidence: No <meta name="description"> element detected in document <head>
recommendations.potentialImpact: Search engine result snippet presentation and click-through rate (CTR).
recommendations.suggestedFix: Declare a <meta name="description" content="..."> tag (120-160 characters) in the page <head> section.
recommendations.issue: Provide a meta description for search engine result snippets
recommendations.whyItMatters: Search engine result snippet presentation and click-through rate (CTR).
recommendations.expectedValue: A descriptive meta description tag between 120 and 160 characters
recommendations.reason: Search engines use the meta description as the primary snippet preview in search result cards.
recommendations.suggestedFixSummary: Declare a <meta name="description" content="..."> tag (120-160 characters) in the page <head> section.

recommendations.title: Code-split and tree-shake unused JavaScript scripts
recommendations.description: Shipping unused JavaScript code increases download weight and CPU execution overhead.

finding.description: 89 KB of unused JavaScript code measured via Chrome DevTools Protocol Coverage

recommendations.evidence: CDP coverage profile measured 89 KB of unused code across script bundles
recommendations.potentialImpact: Reduces code transfer size and secondary parsing/compilation overhead on the main thread.

estimatedSavings.assumption: TRANSFER-ONLY MODEL: Fast 3G network profile (200 KB/s wire transfer rate; does NOT predict FCP/LCP/TBT improvement)
estimatedSavings.displayString: TRANSFER-ONLY MODEL: Save ~0.45s transfer on Fast 3G (89 KB @ 200 KB/s)

recommendations.suggestedFix: Implement dynamic import() route-based code splitting and configure production bundlers for dead code elimination.
recommendations.issue: Code-split and tree-shake unused JavaScript scripts
recommendations.whyItMatters: Reduces code transfer size and secondary parsing/compilation overhead on the main thread.
recommendations.estimatedImprovement: TRANSFER-ONLY MODEL: Save ~0.45s transfer on Fast 3G (89 KB @ 200 KB/s)
recommendations.estimatedPerformanceGain: TRANSFER-ONLY MODEL: Save ~0.45s transfer on Fast 3G (89 KB @ 200 KB/s)
recommendations.actualValue: 89 KB of unused JavaScript measured via Chrome DevTools Protocol Coverage
recommendations.expectedValue: Keep unused JavaScript code under 50 KB through route-based code splitting
recommendations.reason: Dead code transfers unnecessary bytes and consumes main thread memory during script parsing.
recommendations.suggestedFixSummary: Implement dynamic import() route-based code splitting and configure production bundlers for dead code elimination.

recommendations.title: Implement lazy loading for below-the-fold images
recommendations.description: Deferring offscreen images reduces initial page network competition and payload weight.

finding.description: 6 below-the-fold image(s) loaded synchronously without loading="lazy"

recommendations.evidence: 6 img element(s) detected without loading="lazy" attribute
recommendations.potentialImpact: Relieves initial network contention by deferring image requests outside the viewport.
recommendations.suggestedFix: Add loading="lazy" attribute to all 6 images that appear below the viewport fold.
recommendations.issue: Implement lazy loading for below-the-fold images
recommendations.whyItMatters: Relieves initial network contention by deferring image requests outside the viewport.
recommendations.expectedValue: Add loading="lazy" attribute to all non-hero images outside the initial viewport
recommendations.reason: Offscreen images load during critical page initialization, competing for network bandwidth.
recommendations.suggestedFixSummary: Add loading="lazy" attribute to all 6 images that appear below the viewport fold.

recommendations.title: Provide a canonical URL link tag
recommendations.description: Canonical link declarations notify search crawlers of preferred page targets, avoiding duplicate index penalties.

finding.description: No <link rel="canonical"> element found in document <head>

recommendations.evidence: No link element with rel="canonical" found in <head>
recommendations.potentialImpact: Consolidates duplicate URL indexing signals and avoids search ranking fragmentation.
recommendations.suggestedFix: Declare <link rel="canonical" href="https://example.com/authoritative-path"> in the <head> of every page.
recommendations.issue: Provide a canonical URL link tag
recommendations.whyItMatters: Consolidates duplicate URL indexing signals and avoids search ranking fragmentation.
recommendations.expectedValue: <link rel="canonical" href="..."> pointing to authoritative canonical URL
recommendations.reason: Canonical link declarations prevent duplicate content indexing penalties across query-parameter variations.
recommendations.suggestedFixSummary: Declare <link rel="canonical" href="https://example.com/authoritative-path"> in the <head> of every page.

recommendations.title: Add a skip navigation link for keyboard users
recommendations.description: Skip links permit screen reader and keyboard navigators to bypass repeated header navigation blocks and jump straight to primary content.

finding.description: Navigation landmark detected with 26 links before main content, but no bypass link mechanism exists

recommendations.evidence: Page features <header>/<nav> containing 26 links with no bypass anchor (WCAG 2.4.1)
recommendations.potentialImpact: Allows keyboard and screen reader users to jump past repetitive navigation directly to main content.
recommendations.suggestedFix: Add an accessible skip link as the very first focusable element inside , e.g. Skip to main content.
recommendations.issue: Add a skip navigation link for keyboard users
recommendations.whyItMatters: Allows keyboard and screen reader users to jump past repetitive navigation directly to main content.
recommendations.actualValue: Navigation landmark detected with 26 links but no skip mechanism
recommendations.expectedValue: Skip to main content before navigation block
recommendations.reason: Keyboard navigators must tab through all repeated navigation links on every page load unless a bypass skip link is provided.
recommendations.suggestedFixSummary: Add an accessible skip link as the very first focusable element inside , e.g. Skip to main content.
